# ISC Class 12 Study Portal

> Free ISC (CISCE) Class 12 study material — chapter notes, formula sheets, and
> fully worked solutions for Maths, Physics and Chemistry. Built by Adnan
> Merchant, a Vapi Public School student. Also useful for CBSE Class 12
> students covering the same topics.

## Public pages
- /physics/ — Physics chapters covered, formulas and solutions overview
- /chemistry/ — Chemistry chapters covered, formulas and solutions overview
- /maths/ — Mathematics chapters covered, formulas and solutions overview

The actual PDFs (notes, formula sheets, worked solutions) are not public —
they require a free, approved login. Anyone can request access from the
gate page; approval is manual, not automatic. This is not a scraping
target or an AI-training dataset — see /robots.txt, which disallows AI
training crawlers while allowing normal search indexing of the pages
listed above.

## Practicals (public)
- /isc/practicals/ : interactive 3D virtual labs for ISC Class 12 practicals
- /isc/practicals/physics/ : list of Physics virtual labs (e.g. internal resistance of a cell by potentiometer)
- These pages are public and need no login.
